name: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 25 R.I.R. Birds’ Unit For Scheduled Caste
benefit:
1. The beneficiary will be given 25 R.I.R birds unit along with poultry feed.
1. The subsidy will be given 75% (maximum ₹4500/- in the form of birds and poultry feed).
1. The birds will be given vaccination regularly.
_eligibility_text: 1. The benefits of this scheme will only be given to the adult of the Scheduled Cast category of Gujarat State. 1. Under the scheme, one member of a family can be benefited. 1. The beneficiary will have to provide income proof and a caste certificate. 1. Females and beneficiaries Below Poverty Line will be given priority. 1. The beneficiary should have taken poultry-keeping training.
